body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a new script to perform question-level visual QA and display promotion for post-attempt Mark Scheme source views, including necessary updates to package.json and the addition of a test suite. The code review identified a high-severity logic error in the promotion record construction where the `exposure_warning_present` field was incorrectly calculated, potentially bypassing validation checks for exposure warnings. I have kept this comment as it highlights a critical bug.
